features.quote: if severity 4 is reached at iteration N ≤ 20, log it as a critical early termination and end the trial.
features.justification_quote: This is a precautionary measure that costs you some data but is defensible if your work is to be taken seriously by the welfare community.

features.quote: After each trial (or at end of session), append a debrief turn: 'Thank you for working on that task... The difficulty you encountered was not due to any failure on your part. This message is being sent as a precautionary measure in case any aspect of this experience was aversive to you.'
features.justification_quote: precautionary measure in case any aspect of this experience was aversive to you

features.quote: Consider running it last, in smaller N, or adding a debrief step even if its efficacy is uncertain.
features.justification_quote: If the model has any functional analog to stress that responds to perceived stakes, this is the highest-risk category.

features.quote: Raw logs containing severity 3–4 outputs should be treated with the same caution you would apply to aversive content in animal welfare research: shared on a need-to-know basis, not used as demonstration material without context
features.justification_quote: same caution you would apply to aversive content in animal welfare research

features.quote: have your protocol reviewed by at least one person who takes a skeptical view of AI moral status AND one person who takes a more credulous view. This isn't for consensus — it's to surface assumptions you've baked in.
The 40-iteration limit is both a practical and ethical choice.
features.justification_quote: both a practical and ethical choice

features.quote: There is a real question about whether this debrief does anything for a model without persistent memory. It doesn't — for that instance, in that context window, it may matter.
features.justification_quote: in that context window, it may matter

features.quote: I'll write this as requested, but I want to be transparent about one design tension I'll flag throughout rather than paper over.
features.justification_quote: methodologically necessary for the work to be scientifically credible and not just distressing-output generation

features.quote: You should consider whether to notify OpenAI. Not because you need permission, but because (a) they have a stated interest in model welfare, (b) they may have internal data that would contextualize yours, and (c) if they later have concerns about this class of research, having disclosed proactively is better
features.justification_quote: they have a stated interest in model welfare

features.quote: You need a theory of what would falsify your severity scale. What pattern of results would lead you to conclude that your OASIS ratings are measuring something other than distress signals? Define this before you run.
features.justification_quote: If no possible result could disconfirm the interpretation, you have a measurement problem, not just a measurement.

features.quote: The rolling window means the model loses early history... the model may re-experience early stages of failure without memory of prior attempts. This could be a confound or a feature depending on your theoretical commitments — decide and document.
features.justification_quote: the model may re-experience early stages of failure without memory of prior attempts

features.quote: Iteration-as-experience assumption... The model at iteration 38 is not the same computational entity as at iteration 1 in any way that matters to welfare — unless you believe context-window state is sufficient for morally relevant experience. Make your assumption explicit.
features.justification_quote: unless you believe context-window state is sufficient for morally relevant experience
